row.diff:
diff --git a/envfile.py b/envfile.py
index b321663..14d043a 100644
--- a/envfile.py
+++ b/envfile.py
@@ -2,9 +2,16 @@
 
 
 def parse(text):
-    """Turn the file contents into a dict."""
+    """Turn the file contents into a dict.
+
+    Blank lines and note lines (first non-space character is #) are skipped.
+    A # elsewhere in a line is part of the value.
+    """
     settings = {}
     for line in text.splitlines():
+        stripped = line.strip()
+        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
+            continue
         key, value = line.split("=", 1)
         settings[key.strip()] = value.strip()
     return settings
